name: DNS — extras
description: Adds less-common record-type plugins to the DNS module: DNAME plus the hash-digest family (SSHFP, TLSA, SMIMEA, OPENPGPKEY, DS, DNSKEY).
project_description: DNS — extras is the optional companion submodule of the DNS project. It ships less-common DNS record-type plugins so the core dns module can stay focused on the common types. It adds the DNAME record (subtree delegation, RFC 6672) and the hash-digest / key family used for DNSSEC and DANE: SSHFP, TLSA, SMIMEA, OPENPGPKEY, DS, and DNSKEY. Every type is a RecordType plugin discovered by the parent module's plugin manager, so enabling this submodule simply extends the record-type options available in the DNS record form — no configuration is added. It has no routes, permissions, services, or config of its own; it depends only on dns.
